emails.send.title: Send Email
emails.send.description: Send a transactional email via the Resend API (POST /emails). Supports plain text and/or HTML bodies and optional reply-to, cc, and bcc addresses.

to.description: Recipient address or list of recipient addresses. Required.

text.description: Plain text body of the email.

replyTo.description: Reply-to address or list of addresses.

cc.description: CC address or list of addresses.

bcc.description: BCC address or list of addresses.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header so a retried send is accepted once.

id.description: ID of the email returned by Resend.

emails.get.title: Get Email
emails.get.description: Retrieve a sent email by ID via GET /emails/{id}, including last_event delivery status.

id.description: Resend email ID returned by emails.send.

emails.list.title: List Emails
emails.list.description: List sent emails via GET /emails with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

limit.description: Optional page size (1-100). Default 20 on the provider.

after.description: Optional cursor: return the page after this email ID.

before.description: Optional cursor: return the page before this email ID.

domains.list.title: List Domains
domains.list.description: List sending domains via GET /domains with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

after.description: Optional cursor: return the page after this domain ID.

before.description: Optional cursor: return the page before this domain ID.

domains.get.title: Get Domain
domains.get.description: Retrieve a sending domain by ID via GET /domains/{id}, including DNS records and verification status.

id.description: Resend domain ID returned by domains.list.

domain.description: Normalized domain including DNS records and status.

contacts.list.title: List Contacts
contacts.list.description: List global contacts, or filter to a segment with segmentId (legacy audienceId is accepted).

limit.description: Optional page size (1-100). Default 20 on the provider.

after.description: Optional cursor: return the page after this contact ID.

before.description: Optional cursor: return the page before this contact ID.

segmentId.description: Optional segment ID to filter contacts.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Resend connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

emails.cancel.title: Cancel Email
emails.cancel.description: Cancel a scheduled email before Resend sends it.

emails.batch.send.title: Send Batch Emails
emails.batch.send.description: Send one to 100 transactional emails in a single Resend batch request.

emails.description: Email messages to send in one batch.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header so a retried send is accepted once.

emails.update.title: Update Email
emails.update.description: Change the scheduled send time for an email that has not been sent.

scheduledAt.description: ISO-8601 time for a scheduled send.

emails.attachments.list.title: List Email Attachments
emails.attachments.list.description: List email attachments through the Resend API using GET /emails/{emailId}/attachments with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100).

emails.attachments.get.title: Get Email Attachment
emails.attachments.get.description: Get Email Attachment through the Resend API using GET /emails/{emailId}/attachments/{attachmentId}.

emails.received.list.title: List Received Emails
emails.received.list.description: List inbound emails received by Resend, with cursor pagination.

api_keys.create.title: Create API Key
api_keys.create.description: Create an API key via POST /api-keys. Permissions are full_access or sending_access.

domainId.description: Optional verified-domain ID for a restricted key.

api_keys.list.title: List API Keys
api_keys.list.description: List API Keys through the Resend API using GET /api-keys with cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

after.description: Return records after this object ID.

before.description: Return records before this object ID.

api_keys.delete.title: Delete API Key
api_keys.delete.description: Delete API Key through the Resend API using DELETE /api-keys/{id}.

audiences.create.title: Create Audience
audiences.create.description: Create Audience through the Resend API using POST /audiences. This legacy endpoint is deprecated by Resend in favor of Segments or global contacts.

audiences.retrieve.title: Retrieve Audience
audiences.retrieve.description: Retrieve Audience through the Resend API using GET /audiences/{id}. This legacy endpoint is deprecated by Resend in favor of Segments or global contacts.

audiences.list.title: List Audiences
audiences.list.description: List legacy audiences through the Resend API using GET /audiences with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100).

audiences.delete.title: Delete Audience
audiences.delete.description: Delete Audience through the Resend API using DELETE /audiences/{id}. This legacy endpoint is deprecated by Resend in favor of Segments or global contacts.

contacts.create.title: Create Contact
contacts.create.description: Create Contact through the Resend API using POST /audiences/{audienceId}/contacts. This legacy endpoint is deprecated by Resend in favor of Segments or global contacts.

contacts.create_v2.title: Create Contact V2
contacts.create_v2.description: Create a global Resend contact, optionally with standard fields and custom properties.

segments.description: Segments to add the contact to.

contacts.get.title: Get Contact
contacts.get.description: Get Contact through the Resend API using GET /contacts/{contactId}.

contacts.delete.title: Delete Contact From Audience
contacts.delete.description: Delete a contact from a legacy Resend audience via DELETE /audiences/{audienceId}/contacts/{id-or-email}.

contacts.retrieve.title: Retrieve Contact From Audience
contacts.retrieve.description: Retrieve a contact from a legacy Resend audience via GET /audiences/{audienceId}/contacts/{id-or-email}.

contacts.delete_by_id.title: Delete Contact By ID
contacts.delete_by_id.description: Delete a global Resend contact by ID via DELETE /contacts/{id}.

contacts.list_all.title: List All Contacts
contacts.list_all.description: List all global contacts or contacts in a segment, with cursor pagination capped at 10 pages.

segmentId.description: Optional segment ID to filter contacts.

contacts.segments.add.title: Add Contact To Segment
contacts.segments.add.description: Add an existing contact to a Resend segment.

contacts.segments.list.title: List Contact Segments
contacts.segments.list.description: List segments for a contact through the Resend API using GET /contacts/{contactId}/segments with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100).

contacts.segments.remove.title: Remove Contact From Segment
contacts.segments.remove.description: Remove an existing contact from a Resend segment.

contacts.topics.list.title: List Contact Topics
contacts.topics.list.description: List topics for a contact through the Resend API using GET /contacts/{contactId}/topics with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100).

contacts.topics.update.title: Update Contact Topics
contacts.topics.update.description: Update a contact's topic subscriptions via PATCH /contacts/{contactId}/topics using a topics object.

contacts.update.title: Update Contact
contacts.update.description: Update Contact through the Resend API using PATCH /contacts/{contactId}.

contact_properties.get.description: Get Contact Property through the Resend API using GET /contact-properties/{id}.

contact_properties.list.description: List contact properties through the Resend API using GET /contact-properties with optional cursor pagination (limit, after, before).

contact_properties.update.description: Update only a contact property's fallback value; its key and type are immutable.

contact_properties.delete.description: Delete Contact Property through the Resend API using DELETE /contact-properties/{id}.
